bodyMarkdown:
## Understanding the accountant salary Sydney landscape

When researching an **accountant salary Sydney**, the first step is to distinguish between the National Minimum Wage, award rates, and market rates. The Fair Work Ombudsman sets the National Minimum Wage at $26.44 per hour from 1 July 2026, but accountants typically earn well above this. According to the Australian Bureau of Statistics, the median hourly earnings for accountants nationally is $53, with median full-time weekly earnings of $2,003. Sydney’s competitive professional market often pushes rates higher, though precise local data depends on experience, industry, and firm size.

## How to convert hourly to annual pay

The standard formula for converting an hourly rate to annual gross pay is:

**Annual gross = hourly rate × hours per week × 52**

This assumes you work the same number of hours every week, with no unpaid overtime, penalty rates, or allowances. For full-time employees, the typical assumption is 38 hours per week, as defined in many modern awards and the National Employment Standards. For example, using the national median accountant rate of $53 per hour:

$53 × 38 hours × 52 weeks = $104,728 per year

If you have a specific hourly offer, plug it into the [hourly conversion](/topics/hourly-conversion) tool on this site to see your annual estimate. The same formula works in reverse: divide an annual salary by 52 and then by 38 to get the equivalent hourly rate.

### Fortnightly pay

Many employers pay fortnightly. Multiply your weekly gross by 2. For the accountant example above, weekly pay is $2,003 (matching the ABS median), so fortnightly pay is $4,006. This is useful for budgeting and comparing salary packages.

## Award rates and the National Minimum Wage

While accountants are often covered by the Professional Employees Award or enterprise agreements, the [pay guides](/blog) from the Fair Work Ombudsman show minimum rates for clerical roles that may apply to junior or support positions. For instance, the Clerks—Private Sector Award 2020 sets a Level 5 rate of $33.99 per hour and a call centre technical associate rate of $37.24. These are minimums; actual accountant salaries in Sydney are significantly higher.

### Casual loading

If you work as a casual accountant, you are entitled to a 25% loading on top of the base hourly rate. This is not an extra you add yourself; the [casual loading](/topics/casual-loading) is a legal minimum. For the National Minimum Wage, the casual rate is $33.05 per hour ($26.44 × 1.25). When using the timesheet, select the casual checkbox to apply this loading automatically.

## Tax and Medicare on your annual salary

Once you have your annual gross figure, you can estimate tax using the 2026–27 resident tax rates from the Australian Taxation Office:

- $0 – $18,200: nil
- $18,201 – $45,000: 15% of excess over $18,200
- $45,001 – $135,000: $4,020 + 30% of excess over $45,000
- $135,001 – $190,000: $31,020 + 37% of excess over $135,000
- $190,001 and over: $51,370 + 45% of excess over $190,000

Additionally, the Medicare levy is generally 2% of taxable income. For a gross salary of $104,728, tax would be approximately $22,238 and Medicare $2,095, leaving a take-home of about $80,395. Use the [take-home pay](/topics/take-home) calculator for a more detailed estimate including the Medicare levy reduction thresholds.

## Superannuation paid on top

Superannuation is not deducted from your salary; it is paid on top by your employer. The super guarantee rate is 12% of ordinary earnings for 2026–27, up to the maximum contribution base of $270,830. For the accountant earning $104,728, super adds $12,567, making the total employer cost $117,295. This is separate from your take-home pay and is invested for retirement.

### Key distinctions

- **National Minimum Wage**: $26.44 per hour, $1,004.90 per week for 38 hours.
- **Award rates**: Minimums set by Fair Work Commission, e.g., Clerks Award Level 5 at $33.99 per hour.
- **Casual loading**: 25% on top of base rate.
- **Super**: 12% on ordinary earnings, paid on top, not included in the hourly rate.

## Putting it together for an accountant salary Sydney

When evaluating an **accountant salary Sydney** offer, start with the hourly rate. If you are offered $60 per hour, your annual gross would be $60 × 38 × 52 = $118,560. Fortnightly that is $4,560. After tax and Medicare, you would take home roughly $89,000. Your employer would also pay $14,227 in super. Compare this to the national median of $53 per hour to gauge how competitive the offer is.

Remember, this estimate assumes consistent hours and no salary packaging. For a precise assessment, refer to the [reference tables](/data) on this site or consult a tax professional.

## Disclaimer

Annual pay here is hourly rate × hours per week × 52. It assumes the same rate every week, no unpaid overtime, no penalty rates, no allowances, and no salary sacrifice. Super is estimated at 12% of ordinary earnings only, paid on top, and stops at the $270,830 maximum contribution base. Tax is the 2026–27 resident scale with the full tax-free threshold. Medicare uses the 2025–26 single reduction thresholds because the 2026–27 reduction thresholds were not confirmed here. HELP, the Medicare levy surcharge, and salary packaging are not deducted. This is an estimate, not a determination of your pay or tax.
